source: Twelve Data XAU/USD research series at two resolutions

interpretation_rule.exact_equality: preferred but not assumed across independently requested vendor resolutions
interpretation_rule.model_resolution_claim: if material close discrepancies exist, 15m-vs-1h performance cannot be attributed purely to sampling resolution without a same-source-derived 1h control
interpretation_rule.next_if_mismatch: derive 1h XAU deterministically from the governed 15m XAU archive and rerun the matched resolution test
